name: Verify Counseling Protocol, Open Q&A & Safety Guardrails
description: Kiro agent hook that triggers whenever the AI service, schema, or steering prompt is updated to ensure the 1-question-at-a-time rule, open-ended user question handling, Phase 1 financial constraint logic, Zod validation, and mandatory crisis intervention stay in sync.

action.prompt: Verify that src/services/counselorAI.js, src/ghostSchema.js, and src/App.jsx strictly adhere to .kiro/steering/friendly_ghost_counselor_system_prompt.md and .kiro/rules.md: (1) Only one question is asked per turn while any direct user question is answered first, (2) Phase 1 Reality Check constraints prevent recommending unaffordable 4-year out-of-state universities when finances are tight, (3) all AI responses validate against GhostResponseSchema, and (4) MANDATORY_SAFETY_RESPONSE triggers immediately on crisis keywords.
